chapters.label: Twelve seconds
chapters.text: The 2023 FA Cup final at Wembley. Manchester City kick off! The ball goes back to the keeper, Stefan Ortega... he kicks it long. Erling Haaland heads it on. The ball pops up, and İlkay Gündoğan volleys it! Goal! After just twelve seconds!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Gündoğan watches the ball drop. He keeps his head over it, and swings his right foot through. Laces!

chapters.label: Top corner
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the ball flies into the top corner. It's too fast for the keeper!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Be switched on from the very first second. Watch a falling ball, and hit it with your laces!
